_note: Only list verified openings. Do not add benefits that have not been confirmed.
intro: We look for people who are responsible, willing to learn and interested in practical business work.

why.title: Practical work
why.text: Work on real business, sourcing and digital requirements, not exercises.

why.title: Varied work
why.text: See how different kinds of requirements are scoped, planned and delivered.

why.title: Clear expectations
why.text: Defined responsibilities, clear processes and direct feedback.

environment: Work at Monoha is organised around a clear process. Everyone knows what they own, communication is direct, and follow-through matters more than hours.
environmentPoints: Ownership of your part of the work
Respect for deadlines and each other
learning: People learn on the job: how requirements are scoped, how suppliers are assessed and how coordination is kept on track. We explain the why behind the process, not only the steps.
internship: We consider interns when we have capacity to train them properly. Send your CV through the Contact page and mention "Internship".

process.title: Apply
process.text: Send your CV, and portfolio if relevant, for an open role.

process.title: Review
process.text: Our team reviews every application against the role.

process.title: Conversation
process.text: Shortlisted applicants are invited to an interview or conversation.

process.title: Decision
process.text: We let you know the outcome.

faqs.q: Can I apply if there are no open positions?
faqs.a: Yes. Send your CV through the Contact page. We keep it on file and contact you if a suitable role opens. This does not guarantee an interview.
Only when we have the capacity to train interns properly. Mention "Internship" when you send your CV.
Each opening states its own location and work type.

jobs.title: Video Editor
jobs.about: Edit clear, professional video content for Monoha's website and social channels.
responsibilities: Prepare captions and simple motion graphics
requirements: Working knowledge of a professional editor
Good sense of pacing and clarity
jobs.apply: Send your CV and portfolio link through the Contact page, subject "Video Editor".
